description: The fast pass over a file system: reachability check (resource_reachability), walk (filesystem_inventory) to count files/folders and measure sizes, file_profiles for tabular data-file schema profiling. The reachability check decides whether Egeria's Folder Survey or Resource Explorer's walk leads.
